comparability_limitations: The external ULB benchmark uses anonymized PCA features derived from European cardholder data (2013). It is provided strictly as an independent external reality anchor. Performance on this benchmark does not imply identical real-world efficacy for KIRA's synthetic behavioral feature representation, and the external dataset is never used to train Blue or Red models.
